entry.title: SFC obtains disqualification orders against three former China Longevity directors
entry.summary: SFC obtains disqualification orders against three former directors of China Longevity Group Company Limited over material financial misstatements and disclosure failures SFC · Nov 26, 2026 · EnforcementThe Securities and Futures Commission obtained disqualification orders from the Court of First Instance against three former executive directors of China Longevity Group. Lin Shengxiong and Zhang Hongwang were each disqualified for 10 years, and Huang Wanneng for four years. The SFC found that cash and cash equivalents were overstated as at 31 December 2011 and 30 June 2012, and that the three directors failed to ensure timely and accurate disclosure of these irregularities.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Executive Director Elisa Ng at the Capital Markets Hong Kong Forum 2026: Connecting Chinese Assets, Deepening the RMB Market and Advancing Tokenised Finance
entry.summary: New speech by Elisa Ng: Speech at the Capital Markets Hong Kong Forum 2026 SFC · Nov 26, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「我們採取「三同原則」，即「相同業務、相同風險、相同規則」。此理念很直接：代幣化沒有改變資產的金融本質，只是科技帶來了新的載體和運作方式。」 Elisa Ng, the SFC's Executive Director of Investment Products, delivered a speech at the Capital Markets Hong Kong Forum 2026. It covered connecting global investors with Chinese assets, deepening the renminbi market, and advancing tokenised finance through real-world applications. The speech cited fund mutual recognition, dim sum bond indices and ETFs, and tokenised retail products, and stressed addressing new risks within the existing regulatory framework.

entry.title: HKMA announces official launch of CMU Digital Asset Platform
entry.summary: Launch of CMU Digital Asset Platform HKMA · Nov 25, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Adopting an atomic Delivery versus Payment (DvP) on-chain settlement model, CMU DAP has direct interfaces with the Real Time Gross Settlement (RTGS) systems and central bank digital currencies (CBDC)」 The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced the official launch of the CMU Digital Asset Platform (CMU DAP), developed and operated by CMU OmniClear on its behalf. The DLT-based platform supports paperless debt securities issuance, clearing, settlement, coupon payments and redemptions, as well as tokenisation of traditional debt securities. It uses an atomic delivery-versus-payment on-chain settlement model, connects directly with RTGS systems and central bank digital currencies, and supports 24-hour multi-currency settlement using cash tokens.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong at the listing ceremony of the first company under the new uncertificated securities market regime
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at Listing Ceremony of the First Company under the New Uncertificated Securities Market Regime SFC · Nov 24, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong gave a speech at the listing ceremony of Beijing Xiantong International Pharmaceutical Technology Co., the first company to list in Hong Kong under the new uncertificated securities market regime. The speech traces the regime's roughly two-decade development since 2002 and says it lets investors hold securities electronically in their own name and exercise shareholder rights directly. It also presents the regime as groundwork for future efficiency gains, such as shortening settlement from T+2 to T+1.`

entry.title: SFC issues restriction notice to DA YUE Financial Group Limited
entry.summary: SFC issues restriction notice to DA YUE Financial Group Limited SFC · Nov 23, 2026 · EnforcementThe Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has issued a restriction notice to DA YUE Financial Group Limited (DYFGL) to preserve client assets. Initial enquiries indicate a client money shortfall of about $29.6 million that the firm lacks resources to remedy. Without prior written consent, the notice bars DYFGL from carrying on its licensed regulated activities and from disposing of relevant property. The SFC's review is ongoing.

entry.title: SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong's speech at the ChinaAMC Offshore RMB Bond ETF launch ceremony on developing offshore renminbi fixed income markets
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at ChinaAMC Offshore RMB Bond ETF Launch Ceremony SFC · Nov 23, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong delivered a speech at the launch ceremony of the ChinaAMC Offshore RMB Bond ETF, noting that ETFs connect more investors to the bond market and that active trading helps prices reflect risk and value and provides pricing references for primary market financing. He said Hong Kong should serve as the premier global platform for offshore RMB asset pricing, allocation and risk management.

entry.title: SFC bans Kim Chung Wan for life after misrepresenting academic qualifications
entry.summary: SFC bans Kim Chung Wan for life for serious misconduct SFC · Nov 17, 2026 · EnforcementThe Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has banned Kim Chung Wan from re-entering the industry for life. He repeatedly misrepresented his academic qualifications in licence-related applications and provided a false degree certificate. The SFC found he is not fit and proper to be a regulated person and breached section 383 of the SFO.

entry.title: SFC and FMSB sign agreement to deepen dialogue on global market standards
entry.summary: SFC and Financial Markets Standards Board sign agreement to further dialogue on global market standards and developments SFC · Nov 17, 2026The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) and the Financial Markets Standards Board (FMSB), an industry-led global standards body, have signed a Consultation Agreement. It lets FMSB consult the SFC on draft standards, guidance and other publications, and provides for periodic updates on FMSB's strategy. The two sides will also share information on fixed income and currency market trends. The agreement is non-binding, and SFC engagement does not imply endorsement of FMSB publications. entry.title: HKMA and Swift explore cross-border payment interoperability via Project Ensemble and Swift ledger
entry.summary: HKMA and Swift continue the collaboration to explore cross-border payment interoperability through Project Ensemble and Swift ledger HKMA · Nov 16, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「explore the use of tokenised deposits in enhancing the efficiency and end-to-end experience of cross-border transactions」 The HKMA is strengthening its collaboration with Swift to explore tokenised deposits for more efficient cross-border transactions. The work examines interoperability between the Swift ledger and the settlement layer of Project Ensemble, with participating banks. The aim is cross-border payment mechanisms using multi-currency tokenised deposits.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Chair Kelvin Wong at the China International Finance Forum · Hong Kong Summit
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Speech at China International Finance Forum · Hong Kong Summit SFC · Nov 16, 2026 · SpeechDr Kelvin Wong, Chair of the Securities and Futures Commission, delivered this speech at the China International Finance Forum · Hong Kong Summit. Titled "Transforming Capital Flows into Lasting Value," it covers AI adoption backed by governance, market functions such as the renminbi ecosystem and mutual market access, and building market trust through effective regulation and high-quality disclosure.

entry.title: Keynote speech by SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong at the HKEX Offshore RMB Bond Index launch: “A Benchmark that Helps Build a Market”
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Keynote address at HKEX Offshore RMB Bond Index Launch Ceremony SFC · Nov 16, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong delivered a keynote address at the HKEX Offshore RMB Bond Index launch ceremony, and the speech is now posted on the SFC website. He describes the index as a transparent, rules-based reference point for the offshore RMB market, helping investors gauge value, compare performance and make investment decisions. The speech argues the index's success should be measured by the products, investors and liquidity it helps build, and by a deeper, more international offshore RMB market in Hong Kong.

entry.title: SFC and HKMA hold industry seminar on tokenisation ecosystem opportunities
entry.summary: SFC and HKMA hosted industry seminar on opportunities in Hong Kong’s fast-evolving tokenisation ecosystem SFC · Nov 12, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Discussion topics included tokenisation-enabled opportunities in secondary trading and corporate treasury management, and ecosystem development that accelerates broader adoption in tokenised money and」 The SFC and HKMA jointly hosted a seminar attended by more than 200 financial sector stakeholders to discuss the development of Hong Kong's tokenisation ecosystem. Topics included opportunities in secondary trading and corporate treasury management, and use cases for broader adoption of tokenised money and tokenised investment products. The seminar followed the launch of round-the-clock secondary trading of tokenised public funds on a licensed virtual asset trading platform and Ensemble TX's support for 24/7 interbank settlement of tokenised deposits.

entry.title: Trial date set for alleged failure to comply with SFC notices in market manipulation probes
entry.summary: Trial date set for alleged failures to comply with SFC notices in relation to market manipulation investigations SFC · Nov 12, 2026 · EnforcementThe SFC reports that Oliver Chow Pak Wah pleaded not guilty to three charges of failing to comply with SFC notices issued in July, August and October 2024. The criminal trial is scheduled to begin on 26 April 2027 at the Eastern Magistrates' Court. The notices relate to two ongoing market manipulation investigations.

entry.title: HKMA and SFC co-host seminar on tokenisation and collaboration under Project Ensemble
entry.summary: HKMA and SFC co-host seminar to advance tokenisation in Hong Kong and promote collaborative opportunities within Project Ensemble HKMA · Nov 12, 2026 · Speech · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Project Ensemble aims to expand the scale of transactions by introducing more impactful tokenisation use cases that deliver tangible benefits and support a sustainable tokenisation market.」 The HKMA and SFC co-hosted a seminar on 11 November on Project Ensemble and tokenised SFC-authorised investment products, attended by about 200 industry practitioners. Banks and industry pioneers shared practical tokenisation experience. The regulators said they will keep working to broaden commercial uses of tokenised deposits in settling various tokenised investment products.

entry.title: SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong's speech on audit quality under pressure at a regional symposium
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at Forum of Firms’ Regional Audit Quality Symposium SFC · Nov 11, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong delivered a speech titled "Audit Quality Under Pressure: Judgement, Accountability and Trust" at the Forum of Firms' HKSAR Regional Audit Quality Symposium. entry.title: Speech by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong at the AFRC Regional Regulatory Forum 2026, "From Risk to Trust"
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Panel Chair’s Remarks at AFRC Regional Regulatory Forum 2026 SFC · Nov 9, 2026 · SpeechKelvin Wong, Chairman of the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong, delivered this speech at the AFRC Regional Regulatory Forum 2026 on regulation, judgment and responsibility. He argues that reliable financial reporting underpins investor confidence and Hong Kong's standing as an international financial centre. The speech stresses that preparers, boards, audit committees and auditors each have distinct responsibilities, and that regulation cannot replace professional scepticism.

entry.title: Consultation conclusions on tightening limits on misleading names used by unregulated entities
entry.summary: SFC concludes consultation on further restricting use of misleading names by unregulated entities to protect investors SFC · Nov 6, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「a similar provision under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance (AMLO)」 The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) of Hong Kong published the conclusions of its consultation on restricting unregulated entities from adopting names that may falsely suggest regulated status. Respondents broadly supported expanding the restricted titles list under the Securities and Futures Ordinance and adding a similar provision to the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance. The SFC agreed to a faster list-update mechanism and plans to introduce an amendment bill to the Legislative Council.

entry.title: Speech by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong at PWMA Wealth Management Summit 2026: When information is abundant, judgment becomes scarce
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Keynote speech at PWMA Wealth Management Industry Summit 2026 SFC · Nov 5, 2026 · SpeechIn a keynote speech at the Private Wealth Management Association's 2026 summit, SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong argues that AI is making information abundant, so judgment, accountability and trust become the scarce assets. He says future wealth managers will act as conductors of technology while focusing human effort on complex decisions and relationships. The speech also highlights Hong Kong's opportunities as a cross-border wealth hub.

entry.title: Global investment summit closes with forum on conversations with global investors
entry.summary: Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit concludes with “Conversations with Global Investors” investment forum SFC · Nov 4, 2026 · ReportThe Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Securities and Futures Commission and Hong Kong Academy of Finance co-organised a forum on 4 November 2026 to conclude the three-day Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit 2026. More than 300 leaders from financial markets, commercial and public sectors discussed key issues shaping the future of global financial markets. Over 20 global investors shared views on topics including changes in asset and wealth management, Asia’s investment horizons and the role of artificial intelligence in portfolio management and risk assessment. entry.title: SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong's welcome remarks at a 2026 investment summit forum, 'Beyond the Familiar: A Fresh Look at Asia'
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Welcome remarks at “Conversations with Global Investors” forum of 2026 Global Financial Leaders’ Investment Summit SFC · Nov 4, 2026 · SpeechHong Kong SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong gave welcome remarks at the "Conversations with Global Investors" forum of the 2026 Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit. He argues that Asia's markets, with different cycles, valuations and growth drivers, offer sources of alpha for active investors. The speech also says active investors can help build better companies through capital discipline and accountability, and that Hong Kong should be a marketplace where global capital engages with Asia, not just a gateway.
